candidates.change_summary: Replace the external call's value payload so withdraw sends zero wei instead of oCredit (changes observed transfer and balance mismatch).
Send the entire contract balance instead of the caller's credit (may transfer different amount and change credit vs transfer mismatch).
Move the balance decrement to after the external call (introduces different state if reentrancy occurs and changes post-withdraw balance observed).
Do not zero the caller's credit before the external call (keeps credit set during call, enabling reentrancy altering observable credit afterwards).
Require the call result only if balance remains non-negative after decrement (conditional require alters when revert happens and thus observed state).
